messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
By which date must the Commission submit the second specific report on the assessment of Article 6(4) and (5) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, provided for in Article 53(3)?

response.text: Entro quale data la Commissione deve presentare la seconda relazione specifica sulla valutazione dell'articolo 6, paragrafi 4 e 5, del regolamento (UE) 2023/1230, prevista dall'articolo 53, paragrafo 3?
